units.summary: New one-line helper that returns true when s.ooo is nil. It replaces the inline OOO check that used to sit in the stale-series filter, and it is now the predicate both selection and eviction use.
units.headline: Adds isSeriesWithoutOOO predicate helper
units.reason: A trivial predicate that matches the old inline s.ooo != nil check; its callers are reviewed separately.

units.summary: Moves the stale-NaN check on lastValue, lastHistogramValue and lastFloatHistogramValue into a helper. The expression is the same one removed from gcStaleSeries and staleSeriesRefsNoOOOData.
units.headline: Extracts stale-NaN last-sample check into isStaleSeries
units.reason: Same expression as the removed inline code, so the refactor is clearly equivalent.

units.summary: Now goes through the generic truncateSeries. At eviction time it also requires the series to have no OOO data and no appendID above the watermark taken before the block write. The function also takes a new appendIDWatermark parameter.
units.headline: Stale eviction now also checks OOO and appendID watermark
units.reason: Changes which series are deleted from the head and tombstoned in the WAL.
focus: The watermark is captured before the block write, so late commits are not evicted
With isolation disabled the watermark guard does nothing, so a late append can be lost

units.summary: New eviction path for CompactSelectedSeries. It evicts the listed refs that still have no OOO data and no appendID above the watermark. Unlike the stale path, it does not require the series to be stale.
units.headline: New eviction for caller-selected series with OOO/watermark guards
units.reason: New code that deletes series data from the head and writes WAL tombstones.
focus: A sample appended during compaction with isolation disabled is evicted and tombstoned, so it is lost after restart
The gcSeries maxt check still protects series whose maxTime is past the block range

units.summary: Walks the series' txRing of append IDs and reports whether any ID is above the watermark. It always returns false when isolation is disabled (txs is nil). Append IDs are added in increasing order and the ring is only pruned below the low watermark, so the newest ID is kept.
units.headline: Adds appendID-watermark check over the series txRing
units.reason: This is the safety guard that keeps late appends from being evicted, so it is central to data-loss safety.
focus: The caller must hold s.Lock: confirm gcSeries calls shouldEvict under the series lock
With isolation disabled the guard does nothing: is that acceptable to callers?

units.reason: Core eviction routine that both compaction paths now share.
